deployment_search.native_layouts: bypass rows without microbatching and with pp == 1 that the native layout accepts
deployment_search.interpolation: linear TPOT upper bound between the adjacent measured points bracketing the SLO
deployment_search.acceptance: one fast native run at the best layout's interpolated batch; falls back to the best measured passing point
deployment_search.beyond_native_reach: largest measured point, marked limited, never extrapolated
deployment_search.capacity: bypass KV capacity until a native point reaches it, then native capacity rejections; a KV rejection's reported native capacity batch is measured next
deployment_search.import_speed: native_stationary_refill_not_always_ready is a too-big point; halving/bisection is reused and the limit is native_import_limited
deployment_search.wall_projection: measured wall without the Prefill pass, as measured, against the per-worker 1800s projection; no concurrency divisor

source_run_manifest.selection_scope: highest conditionally accepted per-GPU throughput among the native points the deployment search ran; not a global optimum

source_reuse_manifest.scope: byte copies of valid terminal candidates, configurations, layout screens and referenced Prefill caches; no partial results or control files

scope: validated terminal native evidence; single-cohort Prefill contract-only migration; no control locks or stop files
